provenance.label: LRO LOLA + SELENE/Kaguya TC DEM merge 60N–60S 512 ppd (SLDEM2015, Barker et al. 2016), ~59 m/px (USGS Astrogeology)

notes: The scenario Kaguya TC v2 DTM (a single stereo pair) covers only 84% of the nodes of the 19.2 km window; for the context LRO LOLA + SELENE/Kaguya TC DEM merge 60N–60S 512 ppd (SLDEM2015, Barker et al. 2016), ~59 m/px (USGS Astrogeology) is used, without mixing it with the DTM of the measured window (avoids artificial seams). The level difference between both products is kept in centerBiasM.

Each node is the area average of the product at ~200 m (HTTP range reads of the needed rows and block averaging) sampled bilinearly in the local azimuthal equidistant frame of the 1737400 m sphere (row 0 = north, column 0 = west), same as the measured window.
centerBiasM = 0.3 m: mean of the 13×13 central context nodes (2.4 km) = -1552.3 m versus the scenario grid mean = -1552.6 m. The frontend subtracts this bias so the context joins the measured window.
Lower-resolution context to fill the horizon around the measured 2400 m window; it is not measured data of that window and does not enter metrics or comparisons (metrics = null).
